items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public data display, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, and security-sensitive release. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and permit only bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot documentation provides API access but no redistribution or commercial-use rights; public terms restrict listing, price, derivative, and data-mining uses. Launch-readiness is 0 of 4 tasks closed with 4 open. Technical compliance is only a baseline: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner/consent, privacy, and terms findings. Security and operations sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Analytics quality is yellow, and Amazon's $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 is aggregate and unattributed. Human counsel is required before any permission request or rights-dependent launch decision. Ordinary growth remains conditional, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task closes because authoritative rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent and make no production, tracking, credential, configuration, alert-scope, monetization, or launch-state change.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance; storage, caching, display, derivative, and alert rights; attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown rules; trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising permissions. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident procedures, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory.

Retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked and private. Their compliance checks are unreachable, analytics are not configured, and audience, revenue, attribution, health, and launch readiness remain unknown. Continue only dated execution-owner and reachability evidence; do not change DNS, credentials, analytics, monetization, deployment, or launch state.

Compliance, analytics, site, revenue, and launch evidence support containment-only execution. Do not block ordinary reversible growth solely because telemetry is incomplete, but require existing consent and disclosure behavior, destination integrity, registered affiliate identifiers, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries to remain unchanged. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal lift: Amazon's $4.92 aggregate row is unattributed, and matching-period costs and budgets are incomplete. Continue only existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, repair-or-close review, parked-site verification, and legal/security evidence work.

Maintain private launch gates and continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked because fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results and all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior.
